title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16, a user who does not hold the "admin" or…
description: A vulnerability in Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16 allows non-admin and non-power users to execute arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) commands via scheduled metric alert searches. This flaw arises from insufficient validation of metric alert filter inputs and requires at least one non-internal metric index on the instance.
